neighbors.title: Improved fractal Weyl bounds for convex cocompact hyperbolic surfaces and large resonance-free regions
neighbors.statement_excerpt:
\begin{prop}[Main Technical Estimate]\label{prop:main_estimate}
There exists $T_0 = T_0(\Gamma) > 0$ such that for all $T \ge T_0$, $\eta > 0$, $T^{\eta} \le H \le T$, $\sigma \ge 0$, $\epsilon > 0$, and $s \in \CC$ with $\mathrm{Re}(s) \ge \sigma$, $|\mathrm{Im}(s)| \le T$, the following holds: there are parameters $h, \tau_0, \tau_1$ such that
\[
\frac{1}{2H} \int_{T-H}^{T+H} \Vert \mathcal{L}_{\tau_0, \tau_1, s+it} \Vert_{\mathrm{HS}, h}^2 \, dt 
\ll_{\epsilon,\eta ,\Gamma} C^{\sigma} H^{-(2\sigma-\delta)+\epsilon} T^{2\delta - 2\sigma}.
\]
Moreover, this bound is achieved by choosing $h = T^{-1}$ and resolution parameters $\tau_0 = c_0 T^{-1}$ and $\tau_1 = c_1 H^{-1}$ with constants $c_0, c_1 > 0$ depending only on $\Gamma$.
\end{prop}

neighbors.title: The Liv\v{s}ic equation on differential forms over Anosov flows and applications
neighbors.statement_excerpt:
\begin{prop}   \label{prop:invariant}
  Let $\Phi$ be a smooth Anosov flow with infinitesimal generator
  $X$, preserving a smooth volume form $\Omega$. Then:

  \begin{enumerate}
  \item[(a)] $\text{\normalfont Inv}^0(M,X)$ consists of constant functions.
  \item[(b)] $\text{\normalfont Inv}^1(M,X) = \R \alpha$.
  \item[(c)] If the flow is asymmetric and $2 \leq k \leq n-2$, then
    $\text{\normalfont Inv}^k(M,X) = \{ \mathbf{0} \}$.
  \item[(d)] $\text{\normalfont Inv}^{n-1}(M,X) = \R \: i_X \Omega$.
  \item[(e)] $\text{\normalfont Inv}^n(M,X) = \R \Omega$.
  \end{enumerate}
  
\end{prop}
